description: Where a wallet stands on the way to a funded Cubicle vault, read from the chain (gas, USDG in the wallet, its accounts, the factory's invite gate), and the ONE next step with the tool that does it: connect, add gas, open a vault (vault_prepare), buy USDG with a card (fund_with_card) or send it, fund the vault (vault_prepare), or ready. Also `stages`: the account's stages (the same block as next_steps), and `outlet`: what the vault outlet needs from the account (the second factor, the payout wallet, the vault, the withdrawal), each done, next, later or blocked with the reason, and `outlet.next_check`. Call it first, and again after every step the trader signs.

chain.description: 4663 Robinhood Chain (mainnet, the default) or 36927 the devnet

owner.description: the 0x address of the trader's wallet (defaults to the wallet linked to this principal)

name: onboard
